description: Enerallt is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Aalto University. A multi-country electricity market and district heating model Hourly Simulation of the operation and dipatch of electricity and district heating (DH) production in a group of countries (or price areas) that are interconnected together in a common power market. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Software: Matlab. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Apache license 2.0. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
